verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Qaaaf; wal Qur aanil Majeed

translations.text: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.transliteration: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb

translations.text: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

verses.text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed

translations.text: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."

verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.transliteration: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez

translations.text: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.transliteration: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej

translations.text: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj

translations.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej

translations.text: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

verses.text_uthmani: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb

translations.text: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed

translations.text: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed

translations.text: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

verses.text_uthmani: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.transliteration: Rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj

translations.text: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.transliteration: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wa Ashaabur Rassi wa Samood

translations.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot

translations.text: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa Ashaabul Aykati wa qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed

translations.text: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed

translations.text: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed

translations.text: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: 'Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed

translations.text: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed

translations.text: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.transliteration: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

translations.text: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed

translations.text: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

translations.text: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.

verses.text_uthmani: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed

translations.text: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed

translations.text: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

verses.text_uthmani: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Alqiyaa fee Jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed

translations.text: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

verses.text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb

translations.text: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed

translations.text: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed

translations.text: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed

translations.text: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed

translations.text: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed

translations.text: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

verses.text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed

translations.text: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez

translations.text: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

verses.text_uthmani: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb

translations.text: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.transliteration: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood

translations.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

verses.text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed

translations.text: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees

translations.text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed

translations.text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob

translations.text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.transliteration: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob

translations.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.transliteration: Wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood

translations.text: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

translations.text: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj

translations.text: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer

translations.text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer

translations.text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

verses.text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed

translations.text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
